definitions.dense: One fresh H=2048 BF16 input row, 4096 bytes.
definitions.fp32_delta: Mathematical BF16 difference must fit FP32 exactly. Signed-zero word corrections are separate.
definitions.index: Optimistic 11-bit packed coordinate index, or a separate uint16 index control.
definitions.numeric_equal: BF16 values compare equal. Opposite signed zeros compare equal.
definitions.payload: New values or deltas plus coordinate indices only. Row counts and headers are omitted.
definitions.tile: Aligned, non-overlapping coordinates within one H=2048 row.
definitions.word_equal: All 16 BF16 storage bits compare equal.

optimistic_omitted_costs: Base activation and base projection storage/availability
Merge/addition and native BF16 rounding boundaries
Messages, alignment, counts, headers, and transport
premise: An exact sparse fresh input delta could reduce the dense residual projection.
scope: Two continuity prompts, three physical layers, retained prefill tails and first four fixed decode positions.
